$comment: Spike 002 only. Load with: claude --settings /path/to/settings.spike.json. Registers every hook event the design names (docs/ai-agent-office-design.md, 'Messaging out') against the throwaway echo server on 127.0.0.1:8787 over TLS (decided: https everywhere, including loopback - see docs/tasks/README.md). Launch claude with NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS pointed at the echo server cert, or the hook client will reject the self-signed cert and no event will arrive. UserPromptSubmit is not in the design - it is spike instrumentation, used to timestamp t0 of the chat round trip. MessageDisplay is deliberately absent: the design defers it past v1.
